name: Asana Connector
description: Read and operate on Asana: browse workspaces, projects and tasks, read task details and comments, create and update tasks, complete them, move them between projects and sections, and comment -- across multiple Asana accounts.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List the connected Asana accounts and whether each token still works.

refresh.description: Re-read account and workspace details from Asana instead of the cache
refresh.title: Refresh

return_schema.description: One connected Asana account (one personal access token).
return_schema.title: AsanaAccount

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List every Asana workspace and organization the connected tokens reach.

refresh.description: Re-read workspaces from Asana instead of the cache
refresh.title: Refresh

return_schema.description: One workspace or organization reachable by a connected token.
return_schema.title: AsanaWorkspace

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search a workspace for tasks, projects, people, tags, teams or portfolios by name. Works on every Asana plan.

workspace.description: Workspace or organization name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when the account reaches only one workspace.
workspace.title: Workspace

query.description: Text to match against names. Asana matches on the start of words, not arbitrary substrings.
query.title: Query

kind.description: What to search for: task, project, user, tag, portfolio or team.
kind.title: Kind

return_schema.description: A generic search hit -- task, project, user, tag, portfolio or team.
return_schema.title: AsanaObject

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Advanced task search with filters (assignee, completion, due dates). Requires a paid Asana plan.

params_schema.description:
Premium-only filtered task search.

Separate from `search` on purpose: this endpoint answers 402 Payment
Required on non-premium plans, so folding it into the default search verb
would break the connector's most basic action for free-plan users.

workspace.description: Workspace or organization name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when the account reaches only one workspace.
workspace.title: Workspace

text.description: Free text to match in task names and notes
text.title: Text

project.description: Restrict to one project (name or gid)
project.title: Project

completed.description: Filter by completion: 'true', 'false', or empty for both
completed.title: Completed

due_before.description: Only tasks due before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
due_before.title: Due Before

due_after.description: Only tasks due after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
due_after.title: Due After

params_schema.title: AdvancedSearchParams

return_schema.description: One Asana task, flattened for display.
return_schema.title: AsanaTask

return_schema.title: AsanaProject

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in a project, or tasks assigned to someone in a workspace.

params_schema.description:
Asana REFUSES to list tasks without a narrowing filter.

`GET /tasks` requires project, or tag, or assignee+workspace -- a bare call
is a 400. So these fields are not merely conveniences: at least one of
project/assignee/section must be given, and the tool says so up front rather
than forwarding a request Asana will reject.

workspace.description: Workspace or organization name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when the account reaches only one workspace.
workspace.title: Workspace

project.description: Project name or gid to list tasks from
project.title: Project

section.description: Section name or gid within the project
section.title: Section

completed.description: Include completed tasks (open tasks only by default)
completed.title: Completed

params_schema.title: ListTasksParams

return_schema.description: One Asana task, flattened for display.
return_schema.title: AsanaTask

return_schema.description:
One file attached to a task.

Attachments carry the actual deliverable -- the drawing, the quote, the
photo of the wall. A task read without them looks like a task with no

return_schema.title: AsanaAttachment

tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Connect an Asana account by saving its personal access token, after checking the token actually works.

params_schema.description:
The token the user pastes on the Connect screen.

Not WorkspaceScoped: this is the one action that runs BEFORE any workspace
is known, so asking which workspace to act in would be circular. The
workspaces are discovered FROM the token.

token.description: Asana personal access token, starts with '2/'. Create one at app.asana.com/0/my-apps.
token.title: Token

params_schema.title: ConnectAccountParams

return_schema.description: Outcome of connecting a token -- what got connected, and what is next.
return_schema.title: ConnectResult

tools.name: set_task_dependency
tools.description: Make one task wait for another (or remove that dependency). This is how task order is expressed -- a comment saying 'do this first' cannot be acted on by a timeline.

params_schema.description:
Order between two tasks.

Sequence was previously expressible only in PROSE -- a comment saying "do
this one first" -- which no timeline, no sorting and no automation can act
on. Asana models it as dependencies, so this does too.

workspace.description: Workspace or organization name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when the account reaches only one workspace.
workspace.title: Workspace

task.description: The task that waits (name or gid)
task.title: Task

depends_on.description: The task that must finish first (name or gid). Separate several with commas.
depends_on.title: Depends On

remove.description: Set true to REMOVE the dependency instead of adding it
remove.title: Remove

params_schema.title: TaskDependencyParams

return_schema.description: Outcome of a write, phrased so the narrator can state what changed.
return_schema.title: WriteResult

tools.name: set_task_followers
tools.description: Add or remove followers on a task -- the people who get notified about it without being the assignee.

params_schema.description:
Who gets notified about a task.

Assignee answers "who does it"; followers answer "who needs to know" --
the client, the architect, the site manager. Without this a task could be
created but nobody could be kept in the loop on it.

workspace.description: Workspace or organization name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when the account reaches only one workspace.
workspace.title: Workspace

people.description: People to add or remove, by name or email. Separate several with commas. 'me' works.
people.title: People

remove.description: Set true to REMOVE these followers instead of adding them
remove.title: Remove

params_schema.title: TaskFollowersParams

return_schema.description: Outcome of a write, phrased so the narrator can state what changed.
return_schema.title: WriteResult

tools.name: set_task_tags
tools.description: Add or remove tags on a task. A tag that does not exist yet is created.

params_schema.description:
Tags on a task.

Tags were readable but not writable, so a connector could show how work is
categorised and never categorise any.

workspace.description: Workspace or organization name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when the account reaches only one workspace.
workspace.title: Workspace

tags.description: Tag names, comma-separated. A tag that does not exist yet is created in the workspace.
tags.title: Tags

remove.description: Set true to REMOVE these tags instead of adding them
remove.title: Remove

params_schema.title: TaskTagsParams

return_schema.description: Outcome of a write, phrased so the narrator can state what changed.
return_schema.title: WriteResult
